# pro/vendor

pdf.js 4.10.38 (Mozilla, Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE-pdfjs.txt`), unmodified `build/pdf.min.mjs` and
`build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` from the npm package `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38`
(integrity sha512-/Y3fcFrXEAsMjJXeL9J8+ZG9U01LbuWaYypvDW2ycW1jL269L3js3DVBjDJ0Up9Np1uqDXsDrRihHANhZOlwdQ==).

The claude.ai page (`pro/artifact.html`) is published with these two files beside it, so it reads the chapter PDF
without loading code from another site (loading pdf.js from cdnjs did not work inside claude.ai, 2026-11-23). The page also loads the worker code into itself
(`globalThis.pdfjsWorker`), so pdf.js starts no separate Worker.
Update: download the new `pdfjs-dist` tarball from registry.npmjs.org, check its integrity, copy the two files,
change the version here and in `pro/template.html`.

`pdf.worker.publish.mjs` is generated by `pro/build_page.py`: the same worker with its 30 raw control bytes (all inside
string literals) written as `\xHH` escapes, because claude.ai refuses published text files that contain them. It is
the file published as `vendor/pdf.worker.min.mjs` beside the page.
